summary: Pin awake()/isAwake's shared loud disposition on an unstattable awake dir; retitle the case whose title claims it and whose body denies it

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

pins: awake() throws when the awake dir itself is unstattable
awake() and isAwake both throw on one unstattable awake dir
an unstattable flag inside a readable dir leaves awake() listing it while isAwake throws
acceptance: Each pins[] line has a passing test in tests/Baton.test.ts, and src/Baton.ts's isAwake doc points at that pin instead of restating the agreement.
notes: tests/Baton.test.ts:100 is titled 'both throw' but asserts awake() does not: its setup symlinks a flag *inside* a readable dir (readdir green, stat ELOOP). For the dir-level case construct the Baton first, then replace <flumeDir>/awake with a self-symlink — readdir and stat then both ELOOP, and no permission bit is involved (a root-run test bypasses chmod). src/Baton.ts:44-47 narrates the agreement; nothing pins it.
